top_violation_types.title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver, with direct access to children, was present without a background check eligibility.  The caregiver was sent home during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements- Letter or form from the most recent licensing inspection or investigation. (26 TAC §744.401(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have the letter or form from the most recent Licensing inspection or investigation posted.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements-Keeping Children Safe (26 TAC §744.401(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operation did not have Keeping Children Safe poster   posted.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §744.605(15))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children with allergies had incomplete FARE forms as they were missing one medication listed for each child by the physician.

top_violation_types.title: Site Director Qualifications (26 TAC §744.1017(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Documentation of a site director has not been submitted to the Licensing office. Currently the operation does not have a site director.
